v2_human_g3_exception: Room can be booked v2_human 15:00 on Friday, if given permission.

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: System computes all possible meeting start times for the specified day
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: System shall exclude any meeting start time that would cause the meeting to overlap
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: System shall return all valid meeting times in chronological order

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective of this system is for the user to be able to book a room of their choice based on availability and the constraints
v2_human_g3_input: The input params are events, meeting_direction, day by events = list of dictionaries, valid values are strings in 24-hr format, by meeting_direction: its type is an initial value in the format of an integer representing minutes by day = it is of type string, it identifies the day

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system shall not allow room bookings on Fridays v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: The system shall not create another booking if it overlaps with existing booking

v2_human_g3_output: It should return a list of the format ["q:oo", "calls"] can start at the time indicated without violating constraints
v2_human_g3_tb: The constraint less likely to cause errors in the system
